Task list: coloured tasks you can tick off or snooze
Summary: open and overdue counts and the next 3 due
Quick add: tap or speak a new task
Focus timer: a pomodoro countdown on one task and its steps
Focus mode: the mode you are in; tap to change it
Today\'s plan: the times planned on the Day plan, with your calendar events
Today: overdue, due today and today\'s calendar events
Focus: one big block for your top task
Checklist: the steps of one task, tickable here
Stats: done this week and your streak
Mini month: dots on days with tasks due
Move to the next stage
Previous stage
Next stage
Board summary: how many tasks are in each Kanban stage
Stage list: the cards in one Kanban stage, moved on with an arrow
Do now: what to do with the time you have, with Focus, Open and Next
▶ Focus
Open
↻ Next
Now doing: one board task with its steps, Next stage and Done
Board steps: steps on the board by stage, moved on with an arrow
Matrix: the four boxes and the top tasks in each
Done
Worked today: tick the tasks in one category you worked on today
Worked on it today
Stats chart: tasks added and done each day for the last 4 weeks, with a line for how many are open, for one category
Burn-down: work left on the Gantt chart against the plan, for one category
Calendar: this month with dots on busy days, and what\'s coming up in the next two weeks
Nothing due in the next two weeks
This week
Nothing on this week
Nothing on this day
Previous month
Next month
Month and week: this month with dots on busy days, the week\'s tasks, steps and events, and two clocks
Busy month and week: the month shaded by how full each day is, the week\'s list, and two clocks
Week board: the week as 7 columns of tasks and events, the month a tap away, and two clocks
Busy week board: 7 columns with each day shaded by how full it is, and two clocks
Week load: one row per day with how full it is and what is on, and two clocks
Week by day: 7 shaded day tiles, tap one to see and tick off that day, and two clocks
